alternatives.argument: For ψ=(|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2, the projections give M0ψ=|00⟩/√2 and M1ψ=|11⟩/√2, so each squared norm is 1/2. The normalized branches are |00⟩ and |11⟩; I⊗Z has expectations +1 and −1. The initial expectation is (1−1)/2=0, and the finite normalized local family leaves it unchanged by the proposition, equivalently (1/2)(+1)+(1/2)(−1)=0. This is the complete argument in the B item and is independently supported by the retrieved Watrous and Trevisan treatments.
